items.title: Qualcomm shares jump on Amazon AI chip partnership
items.summary: Qualcomm Inc (NASDAQ:QCOM, XETRA:QCI) and Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN) on Tuesday announced a multi-generation collaboration to develop customized silicon for large-scale AI data centers, with an initial focus on AI inference for Amazon Web Services. The news sent Qualcomm shares up 4.5% on...

items.title: Amazon Just Handed Qualcomm a Slice of AWS’s AI Buildout
items.summary: AWS is sitting on a $496 billion backlog and doubling its power capacity, and the pressure is now pulling a surprising new name into the AI silicon race alongside Broadcom. Whether that newcomer can actually deliver before the window closes is the real question.

items.title: Can Intel's AI PC Innovation With ASU Strengthen Its Market Position?
items.summary: INTC's new on-device AI agent could cut ASU football game preparation time by 15% to 20% while streamlining practice play-card creation.

items.title: QCOM Stock Jumps After Amazon Inks $60B ‘Multi-Generation’ AI Chip Deal
items.summary: The companies will work on AI inference chips and optical connectivity solutions capable of supporting speeds of up to 1.6 terabits per second.

items.title: Cramer Begs Trump Not to Sell Chipmaker That Is Up 311% in a Year
items.summary: Jim Cramer went on live television to beg the president not to sell a chipmaker sitting on massive gains, and the reason why reveals just how much political risk now hangs over one of the hottest stocks in the semiconductor sector.

items.title: Qualcomm Stock Pops as Amazon Deal Ramps Up AI Ambitions
items.summary: The chip maker and online retailer are teaming up to build data-center infrastructure, including chips and optical networking products.

items.title: Qualcomm Rises 5% on Multi-Generation Amazon AI Silicon Deal; Broadcom Ticks Up, Amazon Holds Flat
items.summary: Amazon just handed Qualcomm a multi-generation AI silicon deal that sent shares surging against a falling market, but the fine print raises a pointed question about whether this credential ever becomes a revenue line.

items.title: Qualcomm, Amgen, Novartis, Corning, Boeing, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Amgen falls following Swiss drugmaker Novartis’ disappointing trial data. Novartis trades sharply lower.
